flags.why: The example explains what plutonium is instead of showing it used in context.
flags.fix: Các nhà khoa học đang nghiên cứu plutoni. = The scientists are studying plutonium.

flags.why: Pháp chế in công tác pháp chế means legal affairs, which extend beyond making laws ([Ministry of Justice syllabus](https://vannham.langson.gov.vn/upload/105828/20250908/TB_chieu_sinh_Lop_phap_che_f8a1c.pdf)).
Legislative work incorrectly narrows công tác pháp chế to lawmaking ([Ministry of Justice syllabus](https://vannham.langson.gov.vn/upload/105828/20250908/TB_chieu_sinh_Lop_phap_che_f8a1c.pdf)).
flags.fix: Legal work needs to keep up with real life.

flags.why: Lung expresses a large amount or degree, rather than physical force as suggested by forcefully ([Vietnamese dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-lung)).
flags.fix: a lot; to a great extent

flags.why: Đạp lung is not a natural use of this degree word, whose attested use includes suy nghĩ lung lắm ([Vietnamese dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-lung)).
flags.fix: Tôi suy nghĩ lung lắm. = I thought about it a great deal.

flags.why: Cầu tiêu is mainly Southern usage and needs a regional label ([Vietnamese dialect study](https://vanhoahoc.edu.vn/nghien-cuu/van-hoa-viet-nam/van-hoa-nam-bo/1383-ly-tung-hieu-tieng-viet-nam-bo-lich-su-hinh-thanh-va-cac-dac-trung-ngu-am.html)).

The latrine sense shares the word's mainly Southern distribution ([Vietnamese dialect study](https://vanhoahoc.edu.vn/nghien-cuu/van-hoa-viet-nam/van-hoa-nam-bo/1383-ly-tung-hieu-tieng-viet-nam-bo-lich-su-hinh-thanh-va-cac-dac-trung-ngu-am.html)).
